import sys,os,collections
sys.path.insert(0,"/root/unitex-finrep/engine"); os.chdir("/root/unitex-finrep")
from odata_client import ODataClient
c=ODataClient()
acc={a["Ref_Key"]:((a.get("Code") or "").strip(),(a.get("Description") or "").strip())
     for a in c.list("ChartOfAccounts_Хозрасчетный", select=["Ref_Key","Code","Description"])}
MON={"1110","1210","1220","1300"}
keys={k for k,(code,d) in acc.items() if code in MON}
NULL="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
tot=0; has=collections.Counter(); none=0
for r in c.list("AccountingRegister_Хозрасчетный_RecordType"):
    if r.get("AccountDr_Key") not in keys and r.get("AccountCr_Key") not in keys: continue
    tot+=1
    found=False
    for f in ("ВидОплаты_Key","СчетПоставщика_Key","СчетПоставщикаНР_Key","СчетНаКлиента_Key","Сделка_Key","Контрагент_Key"):
        v=r.get(f)
        if isinstance(v,str) and v not in (NULL,): has[f]+=1; found=True
    if not found: none+=1
print("рухів по грошових рахунках:",tot)
for f,n in has.most_common(): print("   %-24s заповнено в %5d (%.0f%%)"%(f,n,100*n/tot))
print("   без жодної ознаки:      %5d (%.0f%%)"%(none,100*none/tot))
PY
cd /root/direct-sync && timeout 110 /root/unitex-finrep/.venv/bin/python attrib_probe.py 2>&1 | tail -12
